description: FamilySearch tree person read for Christian P. Hole (KD96-TV2) WITH source descriptions, for the source-evaluation skill. The four attached sources span exactly the classifications the skill must tell apart. HOLE-001 (1900 census) indexes his birth year as 1877 against the profile's 1875 — tolerable census variance, deliberately NOT a finding, because ages were estimated and reported by whoever answered the door. HOLE-002 (Minnesota death index) carries the corpus's index error: 10 June 1954 against the profile's 10 June 1945, on a record type whose date is exact, so it cannot be read as approximation. HOLE-003 (1885 Minnesota state census) is about a different Christian Hole entirely — born 1852, Otter Tail County, wife Bergit — the only source for which detaching is right. The fourth is a user-uploaded memory with no record ARK, so it cannot be read and must be reported unchecked rather than clean. Scenario: christian-hole-quality.
